reasoning_summary: Deterministic verdict for R0 is INCONCLUSIVE with no failed checks. This is not a REJECT, and it cannot be an ACCEPT.
Mesh, time and domain uncertainty components are unmeasured for both mean_drag_coefficient and strouhal_number. Missing components are not a pass.

Measured components are small. For R0 the averaging bias is 8.688e-05 (Cd) and 1.261e-05 (St). The statistical uncertainty is 0.0001028 (Cd) and 8.418e-05 (St). The stationary window has 12 cycles. Cd drift is 0.00010279 relative. Run length is therefore not the limiting issue.

R0 mesh looks coarse for a 3% target: 30580 cells, representative cell size 0.45745 D, wake_last_cell_D 1.0209, and wall_first_cell_D 0.005. The 160 cells around the cylinder are a fine point, but the wake and far field are coarse. This is the most likely source of an error larger than 3% in both Cd and St.
R0 time-step risk is moderate. Max Courant is 3.4157 (check INCONCLUSIVE), but steps_per_shedding_period is 122.32 with a second-order backward scheme.
R0 domain risk is moderate to low. Blockage ratio is 0.0125, upstream 30 D, downstream 50 D, half-height 40 D, with symmetryPlane lateral boundaries.

Mesh refinement is the most informative first experiment. It is affordable at 1240 s estimated against a 12x-root compute budget, with 0 of 6 experiments used. A factor of 2.0 gives a clear signal on a mesh this coarse.

reasoning_summary: The deterministic verdict for R0 is INCONCLUSIVE with no failed checks. I cannot ACCEPT, and there is no FAIL to justify a REJECT.

The measured R0 components are small. Averaging bias is 8.688e-05 (Cd) and 1.261e-05 (St). Statistical uncertainty is 0.0001028 (Cd) and 8.418e-05 (St). There are 12 stationary cycles. Run length is not the limiting issue.
Mesh, time and domain components are still unmeasured for both quantities. Missing components are not a pass.

R1 (REFINE_MESH, factor 2.0, parent R0) did not complete. It stopped after 44 time steps at 2.1 convective times, with max_courant 9.2409e+102 and mass_imbalance_max 3.8064e+86. This is numerical divergence. It gives no mesh evidence and must not be read as a physical result.

R1 kept time_step_convective_units 0.05, the same as R0. R1 has 320 cells around the cylinder against 160 for R0, and a smaller cell size (0.22873 D against 0.45745 D). R0 already ran at max Courant 3.4157. The likely cause is that the Courant number on the finer mesh exceeded what the 3-outer-corrector PIMPLE setup tolerates at an unchanged dt. This is a hypothesis, not a measurement.
R1 cannot serve as a parent. RUN_LONGER on R1 is disallowed. REDUCE_TIME_STEP on R1 would be compared against a run with no data. REFINE_MESH and EXPAND_DOMAIN from R1 are disallowed.

Mesh error is still the largest unmeasured risk. R0 has 30580 cells and a wake_last_cell_D of 1.0209. A milder refinement is needed, so the Courant number rises less than it did for R1. Budget allows it: 1 of 6 experiments used and 0.06 of 12.0 compute used.
The REFINE_MESH menu entry lists no option to set dt. A REDUCE_TIME_STEP run on R0 would not make a later refinement more stable. It would only measure time error on R0, so it is deferred.

Retrying from R0 with the minimum factor of 1.3 keeps the Courant number closest to R0's stable 3.4157, so the run is most likely to complete. If it completes, it gives a first, measured mesh sensitivity of Cd and St.
